notes: Head faces -x (nose at x~1), so XY panel is the true profile; ZY panel shows the front/rear (z-y) silhouette and XZ the top-down view, both used only to recover lateral (z) spread and confirm left/right. Animal right = +z (computed from forward=-x, up=+y via right=up×forward), so larger z-tick in the ZY panel = animal's right side, and smaller z-tick (top) in the XZ panel = animal's right side (XZ vertical axis is flip-mapped like the y-axes). Spine simplified to two hub nodes (withers, hips) since the mesh has no distinct separate spine segments visible; neck+head treated as two segments off withers. Front leg simplified to shoulder-elbow-paw (2 segments); hind leg given 3 segments (hip-stifle-hock-paw) per standard hind-limb anatomy, inferred since only endpoints were directly measurable on the render. Tail modeled as base+curled tip (2 segments) to capture the visible curl. Lateral (z) leg spread (~±3 from centerline) inferred equally for fore and hind legs from the ZY panel since exact per-leg z ticks were hard to separate at the small render scale; all four legs kept structurally proportional (not posed) per instructions. Ears/eyes not counted as leaves (sub-flap detail); head counted as a leaf since it clearly protrudes on a neck.
